'''Magazines''' printed Star Wars CCG strategy, previews, decklists, tournament reports, advertisements and promotional inserts from 1996 through the end of Decipher's license.

The parent catalog is [[Media]]. Physical inserts and posters are also listed on [[SWCCG Memorabilia]] and [[Oversized and undersized cards]].
